name: Twin-Battery Water Blaster with Tank
description: An electric pulse water blaster with a 930 ml tank, two modular batteries and a water-storing scope. About 58 × 5 × 27 cm. The box has the blaster, the scope, two batteries and a USB charging cable. Water only. Don't aim at faces or animals. Adult supervision for young children.

source.notes: Style code "DUAL BATTERY 2307" (photo label NO.2307, 930 ml, 58x5x27 cm, scope tank x1, modular battery x2, USB cable x1). Blue and white/orange. The "Double Mirror 2307" at ¥62 (lifestyle photos 61 and 62, 57x27 cm) looks the same as this one with a scope: not listed until the owner says what it is. Same 1688 offer (1089431913643) as the rest of the water-blaster range. MOQ unclear: the page says "1 Box starting batch" and lists carton counts of 12-48 pcs, so whether the price is per piece for a 1-piece order or needs a carton is unconfirmed. Prices are per piece from the style list. Store return rate not shown in the screenshots. China freight ¥4/order (note only, not costed). Lithium battery: sea freight only. Realistic firearm-shaped toy: possible customs hold as an imitation firearm, owner to confirm with the clearing agent. Range is stated only on the 2309 box photo (8-10 m, seller figure) and used there; none is claimed for other models. No safety certification shown or claimed. Supplier photos are 800 px (soft once enlarged).
